items.title: Proposition 8.25: base change of local finite presentation
items.statement_scope: Let a pullback diagram of spectral Deligne-Mumford stacks X′→X, Y′→Y with f:X→Y be given. If f is locally of finite presentation to order n (respectively locally almost of finite presentation, locally of finite presentation), then f′:X′→Y′ has the same property. The complete statement, including all three alternatives, is retained whole; no subpart is separated.
